## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include breaking API changes and consumer impact.

## Ownership

Explain affected SDK, actor, integration, presentation, or localization boundaries.
For shared resources, identify the owner and cancellation/cleanup behavior.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Identify affected unit/browser tests.
Record implementation review approval before adding or running those tests, or state that
approval is pending and no implementation tests were added/run. Mark tooling-only changes
as not applicable rather than claiming implementation approval.
